title: Hybris stock materials
subtitle: The materials whose stock OMS sends to the website (Hybris) for every Hybris stock store.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Hybris stock view grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

neverDeletes: An upload adds and updates materials but never removes one: a material missing from the file stays on the list as it is. Disable a material to stop sending it.

results.failedTitle: The materials could not be loaded
results.viewOnly: View only: editing the list needs the Hybris stock manage grant.

download.failed: The list could not be downloaded

add.title: Add a material
add.note: The material is added enabled. The next delta sends it for every Hybris stock store, whether or not its stock changed.
add.numberHint: Letters, digits, . _ or -, up to 30, as the material master holds it.
add.failed: The material could not be added.

enable.title: Enable this material
enable.note: <material>{{material}}</material> is sent again, for every Hybris stock store, in the next delta.
enable.doneDetail: Material {{material}} goes out in the next delta.

disable.title: Disable this material
disable.note: <material>{{material}}</material> drops out of the files. Hybris keeps the stock it was last sent for it.

upload.title: Upload a material list
upload.note: Nothing changes until you commit. An upload adds new materials and updates existing ones, and never removes a material missing from the file.
upload.shape: CSV or XLSX (first sheet), up to 10 MB and 50,000 rows: a material number column (MaterialNumber, Material, Item, Article…) and an optional enabled column (1 / 0, true / false, yes / no, enabled / disabled). A blank enabled cell keeps a listed material as it is.
upload.readFailed: The file could not be read.

refusalTally.malformed: {{n}} not a material number, or an enabled value not understood

refusal.malformed: Not a material number, or an enabled value not understood

upload.mismatch: The server's counts differ from its rows; the rows are shown.
upload.nothing: Nothing in this file changes the list.
upload.gone: The file or the material list changed since this preview, so nothing was applied. Preview it again.
